reasons.api/fs-*: Sync return/callback contracts and directory existence semantics must be preserved. Nested argument rewrites include malformed expressions.
reasons.api/json-parse-readFileSync: Overlaps fs-readFileSync edits and introduces asynchronous return contracts.
reasons.imports/bun-native: Custom dotenv paths, execa streaming/cancellation, browser-only Vitest, Prettier and AWS clients have non-equivalent APIs.
reasons.api/buffer-*: Buffer consumers require encoding and Buffer methods; Uint8Array is not equivalent.
reasons.ci/*: Upstream hosted CI is provenance; no hosted build deployment requested.
reasons.docker/node-base: Image native dependencies and multi-stage copy paths require separate qualification.
reasons.cli/*: Package manager examples/protocol helpers remain public upstream semantics.
reasons.api/dirname-esm: Retain upstream template behavior until generated CJS/ESM consumers are qualified.
